# Security Policy

EVO Inbox follows the parent EVO Admissions Platform
[`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md).

Do not report EVO Inbox vulnerabilities to the original WACRM maintainer, a
personal email address, or a normal GitHub Issue. Use the parent repository's
private reporting process and identify `agent-lead2-crmwhatsapp` as the affected
component.

The upstream MIT license and attribution remain preserved in
[`LICENSE`](../LICENSE); they do not define EVO's current security-reporting
channel.
